notes: Extreme-return and zero-volume rows are review flags, not automatic data errors.
Macro values are carried backward-only from the last available observation; future filling is never used.

disclosures: The 2023-2025 evaluation period was already inspected in Milestones 2A and 2B. Milestone 2C does not tune on it, but it is therefore a frozen historical evaluation period rather than a pristine never-seen holdout.
The 2023-2025 period has been inspected in earlier milestones and remains a frozen historical evaluation period rather than a pristine holdout.

After viewing these 2026 results, changing features, model hyperparameters, portfolio rules, or optimizer settings because of 2026 performance would contaminate this holdout. Future methodology changes require a new prospective period.
The static equity universe is survivorship-biased and is not point-in-time index membership.
key_findings: Momentum remains a strong conventional benchmark.
Random Forest had the most persistent positive historical nonlinear Rank IC, but its confidence interval included zero.
Turnover-aware optimization improved Random Forest historical risk-adjusted efficiency and implementability.
All learned models produced negative mean Rank IC in the first seven matured 2026 holdout months.
The early prospective result is negative evidence, not a final statistical verdict.
